highlights.title: Wire-to-wire
highlights.text: Ban defense (Gurv) held #1 every single week, preseason through the finale — the only team that never once dropped from the top spot.

highlights.title: Total domination
highlights.text: Ban defense also led the weekly high-scorer count with 4 wins — more than double anyone else — then went on to win the actual championship. #1 regular season, #1 high scorer, #1 overall.

highlights.title: Week 7 fireworks
highlights.text: The season's highest score (202.24, Ban defense) and lowest score (60.24, shouldve just) landed in the exact same week.

highlights.title: Wildest ride
highlights.text: 1-0 vs Gurv opened the year ranked 10th, climbed all the way to 2nd by midseason, then fell back to 8th by the finale — the biggest single-season swing of anyone.

highlights.title: Truth in advertising
highlights.text: Fraud Hoax nearly matched that swing — 9th to 2nd and right back down to 9th — living up to the name perfectly.
